raw_posts.name: AXL
raw_posts.tagline: GTM copilot for AI product founders: 1,200+ actions via MCP
raw_posts.description: Capture leads, close sales & onboard customers in one system: pages, quizzes, webinars, courses, video hosting & streaming, email, chat, CRM, telephony & AI calls. No integrations to build & maintain. Every interaction enriches each lead's history. Our AI model, trained on 1M deals from AXL users, scores leads using 300+ signals to help your AI & sales team decide who to follow up with, when & how. Give ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor access to lead context & 1,200+ sales & marketing actions via MCP.

raw_posts.name: Sage2 by Levanto Labs
raw_posts.tagline: Turn live talk into structured data and instant actions
raw_posts.description: Sage2 gives developers APIs to extract structured data from natural language and make streaming decisions as conversations evolve. Extract values like dates, amounts, and durations, track changing user intent, and build applications that know what to do next.

raw_posts.name: Inkling 2 Small
raw_posts.tagline: A model that can see and refine what it builds
raw_posts.description: Inkling 2 Small is Thinking Machines Lab's new 594B-parameter MoE model with 17B active, built for long-horizon coding, visual tasks, and agents. Available on Tinker for inference and fine-tuning.

raw_posts.name: DocsAlot for customer support
raw_posts.tagline: Slack and Discord bot that answers your customers questions
raw_posts.description: DocsAlot can now answer common customers questions, in slack and discord, based on your existing knowledge-base

raw_posts.name: Deduplication
raw_posts.description: Bug used to mean an insect. Mouse, an animal. Token, a coin. Tech keeps borrowing words, and deduplication.tech measures which meaning is winning. 719 duplicated terms across 14 fields (AI, crypto, gaming, cloud and more). Each pair is scored with live Wikipedia pageviews: the original still owns it, it's contested, or the duplicate took over. Explore the word cloud, leaderboards and term pages. Free and open, by HackerNoon.

raw_posts.name: NoMac
raw_posts.tagline: Your AI agent's own Mac, billed per minute. No subscription
raw_posts.description: Give Claude Code, Codex or Cursor its own Mac in the cloud: Xcode on Apple silicon, ready in about 30 seconds. Your agent builds your iOS app, runs it on an iPhone Simulator you can watch live, and ships it to TestFlight and the App Store. Then the Mac shuts down. Billed per minute from prepaid credit, no subscription: a whole build costs a few cents.

raw_posts.name: Archie
raw_posts.description: Archie — a small Mac app that keeps screenshots in your notch, ready to edit and drag wherever you need them.

raw_posts.name: Zigzag Browser
raw_posts.tagline: The polished, native Mac browser for life after Arc
raw_posts.description: A native Mac browser for people leaving Arc, with the sidebar and spaces you're used to. Built on WebKit, not Chromium, and that's the point: the whole app is 18 MB (Arc is 871). Switching takes a minute. One import brings over everything, so you're already logged in. Colored spaces you swipe between, split view, peek, Chrome extensions like 1Password and Tampermonkey, and ad blocking built-in Open source, no account, no AI. Nobody can shut it down.

raw_posts.name: outages.live
raw_posts.tagline: A free live outage feed for your agents
raw_posts.description: Check whether a provider is down before debugging your code. outages.live brings official status pages for cloud, AI, payments, and developer tools into one feed, refreshed every few minutes. Give your coding agent outage context over MCP, browse the live feed, or subscribe via RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, or Slack. Free, with no login or API key.

raw_posts.name: Agent Clan
raw_posts.tagline: Command your Claude Code and Codex agents with gestures
raw_posts.description: Agent Clan puts your Claude Code and Codex agents on your screen as a 3D team you run with your hands. Make a fist and they appear. Pinch and pull toward one to pick it, then just say what you need. When an agent asks for permission, pull right to allow or left to deny. Circle anything on your screen to hand it over, or ask a leader and its crew splits the work. Hand tracking and voice run on your computer, and everything also works with a mouse. Free on Mac and Windows.
